ideas.topic: The Makeup Secret of the Pharaohs
ideas.hook: Did you know that the heavy black eyeliner worn by Ancient Egyptians was actually a life-saving medical invention?
ideas.why: It leverages the 'surprising everyday object' curiosity gap seen in the viral dress and papyrus videos.

ideas.topic: What Archaeologists Found Inside a 3,000-Year-Old Lunchbox
ideas.hook: We found a perfectly preserved meal inside an ancient tomb, and you won't believe what was on the menu.
ideas.why: It uses the 'what is inside' mystery format which consistently drives high engagement in the archaeology niche.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptians Really Loved Their Cats
ideas.hook: If you hurt a cat in Ancient Egypt, you could be sentenced to death—but it wasn't just because they were cute.
ideas.why: It taps into the high-performing 'cat' trend in the niche while pivoting back to the channel's calm, historical tone.
